missions.title: Say what you think
missions.prompt: Give your opinion about an idea connected to the target word. Give one clear reason.

missions.title: Make a choice
missions.prompt: Say whether the target word is mostly positive, negative, or both. Explain your view.

missions.title: Take a side
missions.prompt: Make a statement using the target word. Another player agrees or disagrees and gives a reason.

missions.title: Defend your idea
missions.prompt: Use the target word in an opinion. Answer one challenge from another player.

missions.title: This or that
missions.prompt: Give two choices related to the target word. Choose one and explain why.

missions.title: Best option
missions.prompt: Imagine your class must make a decision connected to the target word. Recommend the best option.

missions.title: Convince us
missions.prompt: Persuade another player to do, try, or support something. Use the target word naturally.

missions.title: One-minute pitch
missions.prompt: Make a short pitch that includes the target word and two supporting points.

missions.title: Find a difference
missions.prompt: Compare two people, places, things, or ideas using the target word.

missions.title: Then and now
missions.prompt: Compare the past and present using the target word.

missions.title: Make it clear
missions.prompt: Explain the target word through a situation without reading its definition.

missions.title: Why it matters
missions.prompt: Use the target word and explain why the idea matters to people or society.

missions.title: Tell a true story
missions.prompt: Tell a short true story from your life using the target word.

missions.title: Connect it to you
missions.prompt: Describe how the target word connects to your daily life, school, family, or future.

missions.title: Solve it
missions.prompt: Describe a simple problem using the target word, then suggest a solution.

missions.title: Improve the plan
missions.prompt: Use the target word to identify a problem. Give two possible solutions and choose the better one.

missions.title: Imagine this
missions.prompt: Create a situation connected to the target word. Say what you would do and why.

missions.title: Unexpected change
missions.prompt: Imagine the target word suddenly becomes very important tomorrow. Explain how you would respond.

missions.title: Ask and answer
missions.prompt: Ask another player a question using the target word. Listen, then respond to their answer.

missions.title: Keep it going
missions.prompt: Speak for two turns: use the target word in an answer, then ask a natural follow-up question.

missions.title: Show the meaning
missions.prompt: Give one realistic example sentence with the target word, then add one detail.

missions.title: Help someone
missions.prompt: Use the target word while giving useful advice to a classmate.

missions.title: Three-sentence story
missions.prompt: Tell a three-sentence story that uses the target word naturally.

missions.title: Make your own question
missions.prompt: Another player asks you a question connected to the target word. Answer in at least two sentences.
